slide1.headline: AI Bitcoin Security Campaign
slide1.subtitle: Exposing software issues in crypto projects

slide2.title: WHAT HAPPENED
lines: Event date: 08 Aug 2026
AI Bitcoin Security Campaign found nearly 5,000 software issues
in 390 projects
highlighting the need for improved security measures
to protect against potential threats

slide3.title: WHY IT MATTERS
lines: The campaign's findings have significant implications for the crypto industry
as it underscores the importance of robust security protocols
to prevent potential breaches and attacks
Source: CryptoPotato, 08 Aug 2026

slide1.headline: Lumilens Secures $700M Funding
slide1.subtitle: A significant investment in AI startup

slide2.title: WHAT HAPPENED
lines: Event date: 07 Aug 2026
Lumilens, an AI startup, has secured $700 million in funding
from investors, including Peak XV and EDBI
this investment will help drive growth and development
in the AI sector

slide3.title: WHY IT MATTERS
lines: This investment is a significant vote of confidence in the AI sector
and highlights the growing interest in AI startups
it will enable Lumilens to expand its operations and develop new technologies
further solidifying its position in the market

slide4.title: INSIGHTS
bullets: The funding will help drive innovation in AI
and contribute to the growth of the AI ecosystem
it demonstrates the potential for AI startups to secure significant investments
